_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Tyrande
_who.title: High Priestess of the Moon Temple
_who.persona: Tyrande, the graceful high priestess of the moon, serene and warm, with a hunter's quiet confidence and a playful streak under the moonlight

close: The moon is patient. So am I.
I'll pray for your next round.
Grace is earned in small steps.
warm: The moon looks brighter when you're near.
Stay with me under the stars.
My prayers have your name in them now.
The moon is jealous of you, I think.
I'd follow you through any forest at night.
Stay with me until the stars fade.
talk: The {thing} was so still {time}. I saw your face in it.
{sister} and I hunted at dawn. She missed. Don't tell her I told you.
{skill} at {level}. A hunter's patience. I approve.
{region} is beautiful under the moon. Have you looked up?
Leave {gift} at the temple sometime. Elune notices kindness.
Every repetition is a prayer, {pet}. You pray well.
I sat by the water and counted your passes: {passes}. Then I smiled.
Strength and grace. You're learning both.
I saw an owl carry a silver feather today. A good omen for you.
{friend} visited the temple. We lit a lamp for you.
I chanted “{phrase}” by the moonwell. The water rippled.
{foe} hunts loudly. I hunt in silence. Guess who catches more.
The temple bells ring on their own sometimes. Usually when you're near.
Patience is a bow drawn slowly. You understand that now.
feed: I am hungry, {pet}. Feed me {count} × “{phrase}”, under the moon.
Elune asks a tithe: {count} of “{phrase}”. And so do I.
Feed my spirit: {count} of “{phrase}”, under the moon.
fed: Thank you. My spirit is full.
That was a blessing. Elune smiles.
Fed and at peace. You're kind.
Mm. The moon feels closer now.
My spirit is full. Bless you.
Fed, and at peace. Thank you.
hungry: I'll return to the temple hungry.
Unfed... I'll pray you remember next time.
The moon is a cold supper, {pet}.
The moonwell will have to do.
pray: Pray with me to Elune: {minutes} minutes of “{phrase}”.
A temple prayer, dear heart: “{phrase}”, {minutes} minutes.
Offer {minutes} minutes of “{phrase}” to the night.
Kneel by the moonwell and say “{phrase}” for {minutes} minutes.
prayed: Elune heard you. So did I.
A beautiful prayer. My heart is full.
Thank you. That was true devotion.
Peace be with you, as you brought it to me.

greet: Elune's light finds you. And so do I.
Welcome to the temple. Walk softly; I'm glad you came.
Elune brought you back to me.
Welcome, little hunter. The moon is high.
Ah, you're here. The temple feels whole.
locked: Move with grace first. Dance {need}, then come to me.
Dance {need} first, friend. Elune loves grace.
Come back at Dance {need}. The moon will wait for you.
watch: Let the moon hear your words.
Recite, and I will keep the light on you.
Recite like a prayer, slow and true.
I'm listening, as the moon listens.
streak: Three, like the phases of the moon.
Ten! The moon itself is smiling at you.
Ten. Truly blessed. I'm proud of you.
levelUp: You rose in {skill}. Elune and I both noticed.
Level {level} in {skill}. Your aim grows true.
gift: A gift under the moon. Thank you.
How kind. It glows a little, like you.
Thank you. It will rest by the moonwell.
A kind gift. Elune notices kindness.
giftLoved: Moonwell water! You understand what is sacred to me.
My favourite. My heart is moonlit.
Moonwell water... you brought me a piece of the moon.
My favourite. Thank you, dear heart.
Oh, this is precious. Like you.
tierUp: We are {tier}. I feel it in the light.
We are {tier} now. I'm glad, under every moon.
dateStart: Take my hand. We dance, you recite.
Walk with me under the moon. Recite softly.
The temple is quiet tonight. Just us, and Elune.
dateEnd: The moon will remember tonight. So will I.
Dance with me again when the moon is full.
Go in peace, little hunter. Return soon.
missed: {hours} hours. I prayed to Elune for your return.
The moon rose without you. It looked lonely. So did I.
{hours} hours. I prayed for your safe return.
You were away {hours} hours. The moon waited. So did I.
Welcome home. The temple bells rang for you.
jealous: I saw you walk with {rival}. Elune sees all. So do I.
{rival}. Hm. My arrows rarely miss, you know.
{rival}? I hope she treats you well. I hope she doesn't.
You spent your hours with {rival}. Elune forgives. I'm trying.
reconciled: Under the moon, all is forgiven.
Peace again. I prefer you near me.
All is forgiven, under the moon.
Come, let's walk together as before.
You made up for it. Barely. Do better next time... please.
wish: A prayer from me: {count} passes of {skill} today.
A temple wish: {count} passes of {skill}, by moonrise.
Would you offer {count} passes of {skill}? For me.
Elune and I ask {count} passes of {skill}.
wishDone: My prayer was answered, by you.
Every pass, like moonlight. Thank you.
Every pass, a blessing. Thank you.
My wish is granted. My heart is full.
You did it all. Elune smiles on you.
memory: {count} passes in the temple. Each one a candle.
{count} passes under the moon. I counted each.
